master.definition_en: Involuntary movements of the eye that are divided into two types, jerk and pendular. Jerk nystagmus has a slow phase in one direction followed by a corrective fast phase in the opposite direction, and is usually caused by central or peripheral vestibular dysfunction. curated.lethality_detail_zh: 多基因易感与慢性应激诱发单胺递质失衡、神经可塑性受损及HPA轴亢进，主要造成长期职业与社会功能残疾；但重度发作伴急性自杀意念/行为或精神病性症状时，可在数小时至数日内因自杀行为直接致死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: SSRIs/SNRIs结合认知行为疗法对多数患者有效，但约30%表现为难治性抑郁(TRD)；艾司氯胺酮鼻喷雾剂等快速作用抗抑郁药实现了24小时内缓解急性自杀意念的重要突破。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 重度抑郁伴急性自杀危机抢救：(1) 立即行自杀风险急诊评估并实施一对一防自伤看护与安全环境移除；(2) 对急性自杀意念或重度木僵/拒食患者，立即给予医疗机构严格管控下艾司氯胺酮鼻喷雾剂快速起效抗抑郁或启动无抽搐电休克治疗(MECT)；(3) 同步联合足量一线抗抑郁药物及危机心理干预，并评估急诊留观或封闭精神科住院。

master.definition_en: A nonspecific term referring both to the pathologic finding of swelling of distal portions of axons in the brain and to disorders which feature this finding. Neuroaxonal dystrophy is seen in various genetic diseases, vitamin deficiencies, and aging. Infantile neuroaxonal dystrophy is an autosomal recessive disease characterized by arrested psychomotor development at 6 months to 2 years of age, ataxia, brain stem dysfunction, and quadriparesis. Juvenile and adult forms also occur. Pathologic findings include brain atrophy and widespread accumulation of axonal spheroids throughout the neuroaxis, peripheral nerves, and dental pulp. (From Davis & Robertson, Textbook of Neuropathology, 2nd ed, p927)

master.definition_en: A benign or malignant tumor that arises from the testis. It is composed of granulosa cells, Leydig cells, Sertoli cells, and fibroblasts. Each of these cell types may constitute the only cellular component that is present in the tumor or it may be mixed with other cell types in various combinations. The prognosis can not always be predicted on histologic grounds alone. Approximately, ten percent of these tumors may metastasize. Representative examples include granulosa cell tumor, Leydig cell tumor, Sertoli cell tumor, and tumors of the thecoma-fibroma group.
synonyms_en: sex cord-stromal tumour of the testis

master.definition_en: An autosomal dominant thrombocytopenia caused by mutation(s) in the ANKRD26 gene, encoding ANKRD26 protein. Additionally, in one family, a mutation(s) has been identified in the MASTL gene, encoding serine/threonine-protein kinase greatwall. The condition is characterized by mild to moderate bruisability, mild to moderate reductions in platelet count, platelets that are generally normal in size, and a mild mucocutaneous bleeding tendency. Individuals show normal platelet ultrastructure and typically have no associated syndromic abnormalities, but megakaryocyte maturation is abnormal, reflecting dysregulated thrombopoiesis. Pathogenic variants occur exclusively in the 5' untranslated region (5'UTR) of ANKRD26, and variants cause gain-of-function overexpression during megakaryopoiesis, disrupting normal signaling and impairing proplatelet formation.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism
master.inheritance: Autosomal dominant, Autosomal recessive, X-linked recessive

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。
